Title: After resolution effects vs "end the action"

Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Heys again!

My question is the following: Ariadne bleeds with Force of Will and for some strange reason she does that without Daring the Dawn or Day Operation. My prey attempts to block. Ariadne's vile plot has come to fulfillment: She plays a Kiss of Ra sending the clueless vampire to torpor while she's avoiding Fore of Will's effect. Is this parable valid?

Kiss of Ra, The

[Action Modifier] Action Modifier

[Fortitude] Fortitude

[3 Blood]

Only usable when a vampire who does not have Fortitude attempts to block this acting minion.
[for] The block attempt is canceled, the blocking vampire burns 2 blood, and the current action is ended (without combat).
[FOR] As above, and send the blocking vampire to torpor.

Force of Will

[Action] Action

[Fortitude] Fortitude

[1 Blood]

Only usable by a tapped vampire.
[for]  Bleed with +1 bleed. After resolution, this vampire takes 2 unpreventable aggravated damage even if the action is blocked.
[FOR] As above, but with +2 bleed, and the acting vampire takes only 1 unpreventable aggravated damage.

NC of Hungary

///

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
I'd be inclined to say that after Kiss of Ra ends the current action the action has now been resolved and Ariadne (FOR) takes 1 unpreventtable aggravated.

Messages.Author: Malachy
Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Malachy wrote:
> Change of Target differs from Kiss of Ra because the action is never blocked but attempted to block. I know this is not your point, but according to your 2002 LSJ ruling, there IS a resolution after "end the action" effect in which the damage is dealt. Is this a special case with FoW or am I missing something?
>
FoW is special because the damage effect is applied even if the action is not successful.
The only way not to take the damage from FoW is to cancel the action at some point, which is not the case here (Kiss of Ra doesn't cancel the action).
Even if FoW would fizzle (acting has 1 blood, is blocked, continues with Form of Mist burning his last blood), the acting would take the agg damage (fizzle actions are "successful").
